details:
Guided Mode was super thought out for all users. Can we please have it brought back?

There were functions of Guided Mode that I would use, such as choosing a new instance for me to join; I enjoyed the roulette function of these curated worlds. Even if there is now a search bar function for the settings, sometimes Guided Mode has what you need in a pinch.

There's a few things that may help improve user experience with Guided Mode:

-Implement a toggle for the Guided Mode button on the Quick Menu, for those who do not wish to see it

-Guided Mode can now be localized to different languages, thank to the Crowdin system.

-When choosing a new instance to join, it should be kept in mind that a majority of mainstream public worlds are mostly English speakers. Ask the user what languages they speak (or choose the languages from their profile, if they have them selected)

--Match their languages on worlds that are compatible.

---Find Group Public instances, on groups that match the user's language.

----More crafty, find users sharing the same language who are active in [group] public instances, and have them meet.

( Implement this too: https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/world-language-tagging )

(( This feature is technically Tracked: https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/open-beta-feedbackrebuild-the-guide-menu ))
title: Bring back Guided Mode
